nodes.label: Content reader gate (SMS code via Twilio Verify, horkos_lecteur cookie, content_leads)
nodes.norm_label: content reader gate (sms code via twilio verify, horkos_lecteur cookie, content_leads)
nodes.rationale: Server never sends reserved content before unlock (blurred 120px preview, fake article text; migration 034 hides articles.content and guides.pdf_url from anon). Geo permissions + Fraud Guard needed because rate limiting is fail-open and SMS pumping is the classic fraud.

nodes.label: Three roles + RLS (is_staff) + proxy route protection
nodes.norm_label: three roles + rls (is_staff) + proxy route protection

nodes.label: Staff MFA (TOTP) - ready but disabled
nodes.rationale: Disabled by decision of 18 Sept 2026 because the team has no authenticator app yet; enabled via Supabase TOTP + STAFF_MFA_REQUIRED=true. Accepted risk: staff passwords guessable via public anon key against Supabase Auth API.

nodes.label: Anon key = attack surface (security rules must live in DB)
nodes.norm_label: anon key = attack surface (security rules must live in db)
nodes.rationale: Anything callable with the public anon key bypasses forms and rate limits, so rules go in policies/triggers/constraints (e.g. meeting_url constraint because book_slot is directly callable).

nodes.label: Postgres rate limiting per action+IP (migration 015, fail-open)
nodes.norm_label: postgres rate limiting per action+ip (migration 015, fail-open)
nodes.rationale: Fail-open by choice to never block a real visitor; requires verifying rate_limit_hit exists in production.

nodes.label: Security headers (static CSP without nonce, HSTS, X-Frame-Options)
nodes.norm_label: security headers (static csp without nonce, hsts, x-frame-options)
nodes.rationale: Static CSP tolerates 'unsafe-inline' because a per-request nonce would make all pages dynamic and lose public-site caching.

nodes.label: Manual idempotent Supabase migrations
nodes.rationale: Migrations are run by hand in the SQL Editor in order; each is idempotent (if not exists / create or replace) so it can be replayed safely.

nodes.label: Client pre-start checklist (domain, Vercel, Supabase, Google Workspace, content)
nodes.norm_label: client pre-start checklist (domain, vercel, supabase, google workspace, content)

nodes.label: Positioning: structure wealth, not sell products
nodes.norm_label: positioning: structure wealth, not sell products
nodes.rationale: 'On ne vend pas de produits. On structure un patrimoine.' / 'Le client ne paie jamais deux fois' - advice first, implementation second.

nodes.label: Role assignment lock (migration 027, profiles_guard_sensitive_columns)
nodes.rationale: Role was readable from signup metadata so a visitor could sign up as admin; now staff are born client and promoted by inviteStaff with the service key.

nodes.label: Reuse of Reset password template for staff promotion
nodes.norm_label: reuse of reset password template for staff promotion
nodes.rationale: inviteUserByEmail fails on an already-registered account (client promoted to staff); the recovery link works on existing accounts. Side effect: template also serves ordinary password resets.

nodes.label: AMMC circulaire 01/20 (CIF security regulation)
nodes.rationale: The firm is a CIF regulated by the AMMC (Morocco); every security measure in the checklist exists to satisfy this circular.

nodes.label: Passwordless client auth (6-digit email OTP, Google/Microsoft)
nodes.norm_label: passwordless client auth (6-digit email otp, google/microsoft)
nodes.rationale: No client password is stored; staff keep password login on /connexion/equipe.

nodes.label: Resend custom SMTP for Supabase Auth
nodes.norm_label: resend custom smtp for supabase auth
nodes.rationale: Supabase built-in sender is limited to a few emails/hour; username must literally be 'resend'.

nodes.norm_label: sql booking tests (postgres as source of truth)
nodes.rationale: All availability decisions live in Postgres, so the SQL script (begin...rollback) is the real authority; client/server tests only check logic with mocks.

nodes.rationale: White dominant, bronze reserved for the 'Prendre rendez-vous' CTA; fonts self-hosted under ITF Free Font License for free commercial use.
